# Spacer

Empty space that holds a layout in place.

Information widget · type `spacer` · Made by Studio

[All widgets](README.md)

## What it needs

Holds space so the widgets around it stay where you put them. It is only visible while editing. Use Show on to keep it in one layout, such as Desktop.

## Examples

As Studio writes it in widgets.yaml. Values are examples, not defaults.

```yaml
- spacer: {}
```
